title: aidd recall --json
description: The lines of the team's writing that hold every word asked for: the records, the Specs and the documents in their folders, the ADRs, the glossary, the product brief, the improvement log, and the commit subjects. It is read through the index in `.git/aidd/`, a cache of the files: never a source of truth, never evidence, and never a yes. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

words.description: The words searched for: each run of letters, digits, and underscores in what was given, once each. A line matches when it holds every word.

method.description: How it searched: `full-text` matches each word at the start of a word, through SQLite's FTS5; `substring` matches it anywhere in a line, ignoring case, where SQLite has no FTS5 or the index does not open.

note.description: What the answer is and is not, for whoever reads it: a cache of the files, never a source of truth, never evidence, and never a yes.

matches.description: The matches, newest first where a match has a date, then those with none, each group by source, path, and line.

more.description: Whether more lines matched than the limit shows.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository's top.

reason.description: Why it was not read: a link, outside the repository, over the size cap, or past the cap on files.

skipped.description: The files recall did not read.

source.description: What holds the match. `spec` is any Markdown file in the Specs' folder.

path.description: A document's file, relative to the repository's top.

at.description: When, in UTC: a record's time, or a commit's committer time.

snippet.description: The matching line as one line safe for a terminal, at most 160 characters.
